en: Outgrow's own work: {0} ms a frame
zh: 庭院扩展自身耗时：每帧 {0} ms

en: Lawns, planted beds, now and then a sand pit or a bench.
zh: 草坪、种植花坛，偶尔有沙坑或长椅。

en: Painted wild ground, rock outcrops, log piles; no tidy beds.
zh: 涂画的自然地面、露岩和原木堆；没有整齐花坛。

en: Mowed lawns, hedges, flower beds; no rocks.
zh: 修剪整齐的草坪、树篱和花坛；没有岩石。

en: Worn ground, storage yards with pallets and rubble.
zh: 磨损地面，以及带托盘和碎石的储料场。

en: This city's master switch. Off: nothing outgrows (new buildings, zoned areas, what you outgrow), and nothing is put back: outgrown buildings stay as they are. Saved with the city.
zh: 此城市的总开关。关闭：不再进行任何庭院扩展（新建筑、分区区域及手动扩展均停止），也不恢复任何庭院；已扩展的建筑保持原样。随城市保存。

en: Outgrow is on in this city
zh: 此城市已启用庭院扩展

en: Outgrow is paused in this city
zh: 此城市已暂停庭院扩展

en: Outgrow every building in the city with its zone type's default outgrow type (the Defaults tab), also the ones you brushed
zh: 按各分区类型的默认庭院扩展类型（“默认设置”标签页）扩展全市所有建筑庭院，也包括曾用笔刷处理的建筑

en: Put every outgrown building in the city back as the game made it
zh: 将此城市所有已扩展庭院的建筑恢复为游戏原样

en: Drag over buildings: every one the brush touches lights up; let go and each gets its own zone type's default outgrow type again, first in the queue. Right-click drops the stroke.
zh: 拖过建筑：笔刷触及的建筑会亮起；松开后，各建筑重新采用自身分区类型的默认庭院扩展类型，并优先处理。右键取消本次笔画。

en: Drag over buildings: every one the brush touches lights up; let go and they all get this outgrow type, first in the queue. Right-click drops the stroke.
zh: 拖过建筑：笔刷触及的建筑会亮起；松开后，全部采用此庭院扩展类型，并优先处理。右键取消本次笔画。

en: Drag over buildings: every one the brush touches lights up; let go and their outgrow is removed
zh: 拖过建筑：笔刷触及的建筑会亮起；松开后，移除它们的庭院扩展

en: Outgrown, not, being fitted, and the queue by how long each has waited
zh: 显示已扩展、未扩展、正在处理的建筑，以及按等待时长划分的队列

en: Every building in its outgrow type's colour
zh: 按各建筑的庭院扩展类型着色

en: Each zone type's default outgrow type: what new buildings and Set all to defaults give its buildings
zh: 各分区类型的默认庭院扩展类型：新建筑和“全部设为默认类型”会采用这些类型

en: Every outgrow type and its settings: change one, or make your own
zh: 全部庭院扩展类型及设置：修改现有类型，或创建自己的类型

en: Outgrown by type and by kind, the queue, speed, frames per second
zh: 按类型和建筑类别统计庭院扩展、队列、速度及每秒帧数

en: The numbers come once the city has run for a moment.
zh: 城市运行片刻后会显示统计数据。
扩展新建筑庭院（此城市）

en: Buildings that grow from now on get their zone type's outgrow type. Kept with this city; a new city starts with it off.
zh: 今后生成的建筑采用其分区类型对应的庭院扩展类型。随此城市保存；新城市默认关闭。

en: With their zone type's default, below
zh: 使用下方各分区类型的默认设置

en: Each zone type's default outgrow type, and how many of its buildings are outgrown (open a group)
zh: 各分区类型的默认庭院扩展类型，以及已扩展庭院的建筑数量（展开分组查看）
将所有 {0} 设为默认类型
将这些建筑设为此类型
移除这些建筑的庭院扩展

en: Pick an outgrow type to see and change it. Saving a built-in one changes it everywhere it is used; Copy as new makes your own.
zh: 选择庭院扩展类型以查看和修改。保存内置类型会更改所有使用它的地方；“复制为新类型”可创建自己的类型。

en: Set the whole city to its defaults?
zh: 将全市建筑设为各自的默认类型？
将所有 {0} 设为各自的默认类型？

en: What a building's land past its own lot becomes, whatever the building is: a garden (lawn, fences, beds), a car park yard (green edges, bins, marked bays with parked cars), or paving. The outgrow type alone decides: whatever the building is (a house given a car park type gets a car park).
zh: 建筑原地块之外的土地用途，与建筑类型无关：花园（草坪、围栏、种植床）、停车院（绿化边缘、垃圾桶、带停放车辆的标线车位）或铺装。仅由庭院扩展类型决定：例如为住宅指定停车场类型，也会生成停车场。

en: How a car park yard looks. Clean: a wide grass edge, trees in planters at the ends of the rows, a tidy bin corner. Everyday: grass edges, bins and stock, most bays taken. Industrial: concrete, no grass, more vans, pallets, barrels, skips and containers, dry worn ground further out.
zh: 停车院的外观。整洁：宽草地边缘、各排末端花箱中的树木、整齐的垃圾桶角。日常：草地边缘、垃圾桶和货物，多数车位被占用。工业：混凝土、无草地，更多厢式货车、托盘、桶、垃圾斗和集装箱，外围为干燥踩损地面。

en: How far out from the building its car park yard is paved and parked. Further out, the land is the outgrow type's own: its ground, patches, rocks and things.
zh: 建筑停车院铺装和停放车辆向外延伸的距离。更远处采用庭院扩展类型自身的地面、斑块、岩石和物品。

en: The share of parking bays with a car or van in them.
zh: 停有汽车或厢式货车的停车位比例。

en: The chance a car park's edge is worn, as the strip malls' are: the ground painted, dirt fading into dry grass out from the paving, no grass strip. Otherwise a grass strip with trees. Industrial car parks are always worn.
zh: 停车场边缘呈现商业街停车场式磨损的概率：绘制地面，从铺装向外由泥土渐变为干草，不设草带。否则设置带树木的草带。工业停车场始终使用磨损边缘。

en: How far the land keeps from water: gardens, yards and car parks stop this far from the shore, along a smooth line. The building's own lot is never cut.
zh: 土地与水体保持的距离：庭院、堆场和停车场沿平滑边界，在距岸边此距离处停止。建筑自身地块不会被裁切。

en: How far a garden reaches sideways to meet the neighbour beside it. Very large values make the polish slower in big cities.
zh: 庭院横向延伸以衔接邻居的距离。数值很大时，大城市的庭院处理速度会降低。

en: Two neighbours this far apart at the street still join (one shared fence or hedge).
zh: 相邻庭院在街道处相距不超过此值时仍会连接（共用一道围栏或绿篱）。

en: How far apart their back corners may be (wedges on the outside of a curve).
zh: 两个庭院后角允许的最大间距（适用于弯道外侧的楔形空地）。

en: Two gardens back to back this far apart meet in the middle.
zh: 背靠背的两个庭院相距不超过此值时，会在中间汇合。

en: A side facing another house's side or back this far away meets it halfway.
zh: 一侧面向另一房屋的侧面或背面，且距离不超过此值时，会在中途汇合。

en: A shallow garden reaches back to its row's deepest by up to this much.
zh: 较浅的庭院最多向后延伸此距离，以对齐同排最深的庭院。

en: Reach out to roads and buildings
A side or back nobody else has grows out to a road, path or building near it and hugs it.
zh: 没有相邻庭院的侧面或后方会向附近道路、步道或建筑延伸，并贴合其边缘。

en: How far a garden reaches out to a road, path or building. Very large values make the polish slower in big cities.
zh: 庭院向道路、步道或建筑延伸的距离。数值很大时，大城市的庭院处理速度会降低。

en: A side or back with nothing near it to meet still grows this far into open land. Very large values fill whole fields (and make the polish slower in big cities).
zh: 侧面或后面附近没有可衔接对象时，仍向空地延伸的距离。数值很大时会填满整片田野，也会降低大城市的庭院处理速度。

en: Two deep gardens meet behind a shallow one between them.
zh: 两侧较深的庭院在中间较浅庭院的后方汇合。

en: A garden open at the back closes with a fence or hedge the joining freed.
zh: 用庭院连接后腾出的围栏或绿篱，封闭原本开放的后边界。

en: Every open edge of a garden (not its street front) gets fence or hedge pieces, following its bends and the roads it hugs.
zh: 为庭院所有开放边缘（临街正面除外）添加围栏或绿篱，沿其弯曲边界和贴合的道路布置。

en: What closes the open edges: the house's own fence or hedge kind, or one for every house.
zh: 封闭开放边缘使用的类型：沿用房屋自身的围栏或绿篱，或所有房屋统一使用一种类型。

en: A garden's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving.
zh: 庭院草坪延伸至新围栏，并绕开车行通道和铺装。

en: Mowed lawn this far from the house; a big garden is painted further out (Ground: further out). 400 or more: lawn everywhere.
zh: 住宅周围此距离内保留修剪草坪；大庭院更远处采用地面涂画（“地面：更远处”）。400 或以上：全部使用草坪。

en: How many gardens are painted (lush ground, soft edges) instead of keeping their lawns. Natural and Yard more often, Tidy seldom.
zh: 使用地面涂画（边缘柔和的茂密草地）代替草坪的庭院比例。自然和堆场主题较多，整洁主题较少。

en: How strong the paint of a painted garden is.
Soft lush ground past the gardens and worn ground along fences facing open land.
zh: 在庭院外侧涂画柔和的茂密草地，并沿面向空地的围栏涂画磨损地面。

en: How far the lush ground reaches past the gardens.
zh: 茂密草地延伸至庭院外侧的距离。

en: How far the fainter, wider band reaches.
zh: 较淡、较宽的外围带延伸的距离。

en: How strong the paint past the gardens is.
zh: 庭院外绘制纹理的强度。

en: The ground a painted garden is painted with.
zh: 绘制庭院所用的地面纹理。

en: The ground of a big garden beyond its lawn near the house.
zh: 大型庭院中，房屋附近草坪以外的地面。

en: The ground of the band just past the gardens.
zh: 紧邻庭院外侧条带的地面纹理。

en: The ground of the wider, fainter band further out.
zh: 更外围较宽、较淡条带的地面纹理。

en: Worn ground along back fences that face open land.
zh: 面向空地的后围栏沿线的踩损地面。

en: How wide the worn band along those fences is.
zh: 这些围栏沿线踩损带的宽度。

en: A band along the roads and paths beside the gardens (sand or dirt by the road…).
zh: 沿庭院旁道路和步道的条带（路边沙地或泥土等）。

en: How wide the band along roads and paths is.
zh: 道路和步道沿线条带的宽度。

en: The ground under rock gardens and outcrops.
zh: 岩石花园和露头下方的地面。

en: The wider ground around an outcrop.
zh: 岩石露头周围更大范围的地面。

en: The ground of a storage yard.
The ground of the worn patches in big gardens.
zh: 大型庭院中踩损斑块的地面纹理。

en: How many worn patches big gardens get.
zh: 大型庭院获得踩损斑块的数量。

en: Planted beds with bushes along new fences. Off: no planting, features, paths or rocks.
zh: 沿新围栏布置种有灌木的种植床。关闭时，不添加植被、设施、步道或岩石。

en: How often a new fence gets a bed with bushes.
zh: 新围栏旁出现灌木种植床的频率。

en: The most bushes the beds of one garden get.
zh: 单个庭院种植床内的最大灌木数量。

en: Big new garden land gets something by its theme: a rock garden, a sand pit, a log pile, a bench nook, a flower garden, a storage yard.
zh: 较大的新增庭院按主题增加景物：岩石花园、沙坑、原木堆、长椅角落、花园或储料场。

en: How many big gardens get a feature.
zh: 大型庭院获得设施的比例。

en: A big garden gets one more feature for every this much new land (at most 6).
zh: 大型庭院每增加此面积的土地，就多获得一个设施（最多 6 个）。

en: New garden land a feature needs.
zh: 一个设施所需的新增庭院面积。

en: How often a rock sits where two gardens meet at the street (never against a hedge).
zh: 两个庭院在临街交界处放置岩石的频率（不会紧靠绿篱）。

en: How many big gardens get a paved path from the house to the back.
zh: 大型庭院获得从房屋通向后院的铺装步道的比例。

en: A narrow even gap between two houses becomes a paved walkway.
zh: 两栋房屋之间狭窄且均匀的空隙会变成铺装步行通道。

en: How often a narrow gap becomes a walkway.
zh: 狭窄空隙变为步行通道的频率。
庭院扩展最慢单帧耗时（ms）
已扩展庭院的新建筑数

en: Zoned areas with an outgrow type
zh: 带庭院扩展类型的分区区域数
